# Meeting Notes (2019)

The archived one. Its path sorts alphabetically BEFORE `Projects/Meeting
Notes.md`, which is exactly why the old alphabetical tie-break handed every
ambiguous `[[Meeting Notes]]` in the vault to a note nobody meant.

From here, the ambiguous name must resolve to the sibling in this folder
rather than to the current one: [[Meeting Notes]] is this file.
